description.value:
Trigger A creature enters the theater

Effect The trap launches a series of simulations at a dizzying pace, each slightly different from the previous one. All creatures in area B6 who can see must attempt a @Check[will|dc:20] save. The trap the rolls initiative.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} for 1 round.

Failure The target takes @Damage[2d4[mental]] damage and is sickened 1.

Critical Failure The target takes @Damage[4d4[mental]] damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2}.

details.description: A rapid sequence of dizzying simulations plays throughout the theater.
details.disable: @Check[arcana|dc:17], @Check[nature|dc:17], @Check[occultism|dc:17], or @Check[religion|dc:17] (trained) to siphon the magical energy, or @Check[thievery|dc:19] (trained) to disrupt the holograms, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (2nd rank; counteract DC 16)
details.routine: (1 action) The hazard plays a new simulation each round, forcing all creatures who can sense it to attempt a new save.
